Granite Grip.name: Granite Grip
Granite Grip.description: The user lays a palm on the floor and the stone flows up over the feet of a target within a few strides, or over their hands and knees if they are down, then sets hard. The target cannot move the held limbs until they break the stone with a heavy blow or tools or the user softens it, and the stone grips without crushing. Strain: moderate.
